headline: Bengaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Timetable
summary: Details regarding the schedule and timetable for the newly introduced Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat Express have been released. The route travels through the scenic Western Ghats.

headline: Bengaluru to Goa Vande Bharat Launched
summary: A new Vande Bharat train connecting Bengaluru to Goa via Mangaluru will take approximately 13 hours. Meanwhile, the previous Madgaon-Mangaluru service has been discontinued.

headline: New Vande Bharat Route Through Western Ghats
summary: Passengers can soon travel between Bengaluru and Goa on a Vande Bharat Express traversing the scenic Western Ghats. The journey is expected to last around 13 hours.

headline: Goa Cop Booked for Sexual Assault
summary: A Goa police inspector and an associate have been booked after a minor girl was allegedly sexually assaulted multiple times inside a Crime Branch office. The victim had originally visited authorities regarding a cyber complaint.

summary: An FIR has been registered against a Crime Branch police inspector and a woman following allegations of sexual assault against a minor. The incident reportedly occurred within a police facility.

summary: A police inspector in Goa has been accused of sexually assaulting a teenage girl at a police station after she was summoned regarding a cyber complaint. Legal and departmental actions have been initiated against the officer.

summary: A major fire broke out in Vasco's Sunday Market ahead of Diwali, damaging or destroying roughly 150 shops. The Chief Minister has pledged government support to the affected traders.

headline: Fire Ravages Vasco Sunday Market
